Search records by free text

Usage: papyrus search [OPTIONS] <query>

Arguments:
  <query>  Free-text search term or phrase. Quote phrases that contain spaces

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --type <type>    Restrict to record types. Repeatable. Default: all types [possible values: task, milestone, release, decision, doc]
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --limit <n>      Maximum number of results. Must be a positive integer
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
